title: Grid Commissioning
briefing: Bridge the Tech Wave generator tier into readable scans, mapped rooms, component recipes, and Terminal next steps.

objectives.label: Scan a PowerGrid node with Lens
objectives.detail: Scan a reinforced generator, Field Battery Bank, high-voltage cable, or Factory Substation to reveal Index, MissionCore, and HoloMap hints.

objectives.label: Mark the Factory Substation anchor
objectives.detail: Confirm a HoloMap marker uses the factory_substation_anchor id near the grid boundary.

objectives.label: Assemble support components
objectives.detail: Use Component Assembler recipes for photovoltaic arrays, biofuel turbines, ceramic insulators, and high-voltage buses.

objectives.label: Review the Terminal next-step summary
objectives.detail: Open the Power Grid Terminal tab and use the next-step line before scaling the machine hall.

rewards.label: Unlock the Terminal Next Steps Index page.
